title: Module Review Quiz: Conditionals & Control Flow (CPP_127 to CPP_136)

slides.title: Conditionals & Control Flow Overview
slides.prompt: This Module Quiz covers if, else, else-if statements, nested conditionals, switch statements, break/continue keywords, and truthy/falsy evaluation in C++ (CPP_127 to CPP_136).

slides.title: Basic If Statement (CPP_127)
slides.prompt: Fill in the keyword used to execute a code block only if a specified condition is true.

slides.title: Else Branch (CPP_128)
slides.prompt: Which keyword provides an alternative code block to execute when the 'if' condition evaluates to false?

slides.title: Else-If Ladder (CPP_129)
slides.prompt: Fill in the missing keywords to test a second condition if the first condition is false.

slides.title: Nested Conditionals (CPP_130)
slides.prompt: What is a 'nested if statement' in C++?
options: An if statement placed inside another if or else block
An if statement with multiple conditions using &&
A switch statement converted into if statements
An if statement placed inside a loop only
slides.correctAnswer: An if statement placed inside another if or else block

slides.title: Switch Statement (CPP_131)
slides.prompt: Fill in the keyword used to introduce a multi-way branch selection based on a discrete value.

slides.title: Switch Case Labels (CPP_132)
slides.prompt: Which keyword is used inside a switch statement to define an individual match condition?

slides.title: Switch Break Keyword (CPP_133)
slides.prompt: Fill in the keyword used to exit a switch block after a case is executed.

slides.title: Default Switch Case (CPP_134)
slides.prompt: What role does the 'default' case play in a switch statement?
options: It executes when none of the specified case values match
It runs before any other case statement
slides.correctAnswer: It executes when none of the specified case values match

slides.title: Default Keyword (CPP_134)
slides.prompt: Fill in the keyword for the fallback block in a switch statement.

slides.title: Ternary Operator vs If-Else (CPP_135)
slides.prompt: Which expression is equivalent to: if (x > 0) y = 1; else y = 0;

slides.title: Short-Circuit Evaluation (CPP_136)
slides.prompt: Fill in the logical operator that skips evaluating the second condition if the first is false.

slides.title: Switch Statement Data Types (CPP_131)
slides.prompt: Which of the following data types CANNOT be evaluated in a standard C++ switch expression?

slides.title: Boolean Condition (CPP_127)
slides.prompt: Fill in the boolean value needed to ensure an 'if' block always executes.

slides.title: Fall-Through Behavior (CPP_133)
slides.prompt: What happens if a 'case' in a switch statement does not end with a 'break' statement?
options: Execution continues into the next case automatically
slides.correctAnswer: Execution continues into the next case automatically
